title: How to Get Costumes
summary: The many ways to get costumes on the NEED server.

blocks.text: On the NEED server, costumes come from many kinds of content.
Field hunting and boss monsters have a chance to drop a NEED Costume Box.

items: Low drop chance from regular field monsters
An extra chance from boss monsters
Opening the box gives 1 of many costumes

blocks.text: Events can give costume boxes or limited costumes.
Exchange Silvervine Fruit for new costumes.

blocks.title: Linked to the roadmap
blocks.text: Silvervine Fruit exchange costumes will be added step by step as the server roadmap progresses.
More ways to get costumes from different content will keep being added.
